references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep themselves to the Lord's commands without turning to the right or to the left, using the same language as Joshua uses.
The king shall not turn from the law, either to the right or to the left, the same exhortation concerning faithfulness to the Law of Moses.
The blessings are conditioned on obedience to the commands without turning to the right or to the left.
Moses exhorts the people to be courageous and strong, the same encouragement that Joshua gives here.
God commands Joshua to hold fast to the Book of the Law of Moses and to be courageous, a direct parallel to Joshua's own exhortation to the people.
Proverbs exhorts one not to turn to the right or to the left, but to stay on the path of righteousness.
Isaiah describes how the Lord will guide the people so that they do not turn to the right or to the left.
David exhorts Solomon to keep the Lord's commands as written in the Law of Moses, the same theme of faithfulness to the Book of the Law.
